svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Cut 45 x 120 mm softwood to 1,020 mm, ends square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: In each end: two 9 mm holes along the length, 52 mm deep, centred in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the thickness, 20 and 80 mm up from the lower edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: In the inside face: two 10 mm cross dowel holes 30 mm deep, 40 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the end, at the same heights.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cross rail screws: 4 mm pilot holes right through, 63 and 106 mm up

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the lower edge, at 210, 510, 757.5 and 1,005 mm from the left end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: butts between the legs, flush with their tops and outside faces,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on two M8 x 120 bolts and cross dowels at each end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The cross rails butt against the inside face; brackets hold the top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the two aprons are the same length within 0.5 mm.
